products.title: The Sofia Woven Tote
products.descriptionHtml:
Structured where other straw bags slouch. The Sofia is hand-woven from natural straw and finished with smooth leather handles, a fold-over flap, and crossed front straps — a clean, considered take on the warm-weather tote.

Its structured body holds its shape from the first wear to the last day of the season, with a roomy interior that swallows a towel, a book, and everything in between. Contrast stitching on every leather edge. No hardware, no logos.

Built for market mornings, harbor walks, and lunches that run long into the afternoon.
